description: The SELECT WHEN clause of a record description entry (the condition-name condition under which the entry is associated with a record during input and output operations), ISO/IEC 1989:2002 13.16.49 and 2023 13.18.51 - introduced 2002 (SELECT WHEN has no COBOL-85 form). kb/Work PB5578.
source:
IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
PROGRAM-ID. SWH9CL.
ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
FILE-CONTROL.
    SELECT F1 ASSIGN TO "swh9cl.dat".
DATA DIVISION.
FILE SECTION.
FD F1 RECORD IS VARYING IN SIZE FROM 1 TO 20 CHARACTERS
    FORMAT CHARACTER DATA.
01 R1 SELECT WHEN IS-A.
    05 R1-KEY PIC X.
        88 IS-A VALUE "A".
    05 R1-TXT PIC X(4).
01 R2 SELECT WHEN OTHER.
    05 R2-KEY PIC X.
    05 R2-NUM PIC 9(4).
PROCEDURE DIVISION.
MAIN.
    STOP RUN.
